answer: One haven, one fate. Thirty haven pools of ten open each epoch: each identity locks 60 POA in the pool vault; admission needs seven signatures from members risking their own stake. Pools reshuffle 20% each epoch, so fakes cannot stay together. Poolmates cross-audit live in a 20-minute window, each replaying a poolmate's task until the echo matches; one operator covers at most two audits, so ten fakes need five hands. A conviction burns the fake's 60 POA plus 10 per poolmate; nectar flows only to pools clean for three epochs. Ten fakes lock 600 POA, beg 70 signatures, face 10 audits a window.
